task.title: P6-138 residue: blur/Escape mid-defer, in-debounce-window e2e sub-case, bench section for stale props
task.description: From P6-138 review (2026-08-12), all minor: (1) rail.rs ~:1063-1075 — a deferred Enter still lands after the user blurs/Escapes the input mid-defer (box-text guard prevents wrong sets; the surprise is that it fires at all after focus left) — consider cancelling on blur/Escape. (2) The race e2e covers Enter-during-fetch-flight but not Enter-inside-the-250ms-debounce-window (shared code path, uncovered sub-case) and uses a fixed 400ms sleep to straddle the boundary. (3) app/src/bench/command.rs — the /dev/components bench doesn't demonstrate the new opt-in stale/on_stale_enter props.
